note: Adapted from the species description of Emerson, originally in English, which treats the alate, major soldier, minor soldier and major worker; the synonymy of A. unsgaardi and the discussion of the merging of the subspecies kohli and lujde are omitted; figure numbers, locality and feeding records are omitted.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Major soldier: head rectangular, reddish yellow brown. Antennae 19–21-segmented. Labrum broad, hyaline apically. Mandibles black, left mandible with a stout tooth. Short setae around the fontanelle, with a spine in front of it. Mesonotum and metanotum pointed laterally but without lateral spines. Anterior margin of the pronotum with two large spines, the sides sharp and converging posteriorly. Head length 3.67–4.00 mm; head width 1.83–2.10 mm; pronotum including the spines 1.00 mm long, 1.67 mm at the middle, 1.30–1.60 mm wide; hind tibia 2.00–2.20 mm long; left mandible 1.33–1.37 mm long. Minor soldier: antennae 20-segmented, segment 3 much longer than segment 2, segment 2 shorter than segment 4. Head length 2.40–2.60 mm; head width 1.10 mm; pronotum width 0.78 mm; pronotum including the spines 0.60 mm long, 0.44 mm at the middle; hind tibia 1.89 mm long; left mandible 1.10 mm long.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Major worker only: antennae 21-segmented; head length 2.30 mm, head width 2.00 mm. The minor worker and other characters are not recorded.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head dark brown, mandibles yellow with black tips. Antennae 23-segmented, segment 2 longer than segment 3, segments 3 and 4 equal in length. Compound eyes relatively small, their distance to the lower margin of the head about equal to their distance to the ocelli. Ocelli elongate in dorsal view, oval in profile, separated from the compound eye by more than their diameter. Labrum yellow. Postclypeus yellow, contrasting with the colour of the head, with a median longitudinal line. Anterior margin of the pronotum notched at the middle, the sides straight and converging posteriorly, posterior margin broadly concave. Posterior margins of the mesonotum and metanotum broadly concave. Wing membrane pale and transparent; costa, radius and basal vein opaque, brown to yellow; the outer part of the media and cubitus only faintly visible, the media not parallel to the radius and with numerous branches. Length with wings 29.00 mm; body length without wings 15.00 mm; head length 2.78 mm; head width 2.20–2.30 mm; antennal length 3.80 mm; compound eye diameter 0.53–0.55 mm; pronotum 1.27 mm long, 2.00–2.20 mm wide; hind tibia 3.00 mm long; left mandible 1.33 mm long; forewing 22.00–23.00 mm long, 5.50 mm wide. Similar to A. militaris, from which it differs in the smaller compound eyes and their greater distance from the ocelli.
